translations.web: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
translations.bsb: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
translations.kjv: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
translations.asv: For thou hast made of a city a heap, of a fortified city a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
